title: VoxasVoice
description: VoxasVoice is a low-latency proximity voice chat plugin/mod for Minecraft servers. It supports Bukkit, Spigot, Paper, Purpur, Folia, and Fabric. It provides immersive distance-based voice communication, role-based group channels, end-to-end encryption, mod
body:
🎙️ VoxasVoice

VoxasVoice brings real proximity voice chat to Minecraft.

Talk to nearby players with immersive spatial audio — the closer someone is, the louder they sound, fading naturally as they move away.

⚠️ Requirements

VoxasVoice consists of two components:

Client: Fabric mod
Server: Plugin for Paper, Purpur, Spigot, Bukkit, and Folia (one JAR supports all platforms)

Both are included in this release.

🗣️ Proximity Voice Chat

Experience natural, distance-based voice communication with zero configuration. Simply join the server and start talking.

👥 Private Voice Groups

Create password-protected voice groups to communicate with teammates anywhere on the server, regardless of distance.

Assign roles with granular permissions to control who can:

Invite members
Remove members
Mute participants
Manage the group
🔇 Player Controls

Stay in control of your voice experience:

See who's currently speaking nearby.
Mute individual players.
Adjust each player's volume independently without leaving the game.
🩺 Voice Doctor

When voice chat isn't working, most mods leave you guessing.

Voice Doctor helps players and administrators quickly identify connection problems with a single command, including:

Missing or outdated client mod
Server mute status
Rate limiting
Unsupported configuration
Other common voice connection issues
🎛️ Advanced Audio Settings

Customize your audio experience with:

Microphone selection
Speaker selection
Noise reduction
Built-in voice level meter
🔒 End-to-End Encryption

All voice traffic is end-to-end encrypted, keeping your conversations private and secure.
